# Real Sigstore attestations

Generated by `.github/workflows/attestation-contract.yml`, run 40459499786
(commit 80423ef88e0e23edcaac9d07d8ba62d30bab7a39, branch `fixtures/attest/run`), signed with
GitHub Actions OIDC through Sigstore public-good (Fulcio + Rekor). See `run.txt`.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `semgrep.json` | The Semgrep report that was signed |
| `semgrep.provenance.sigstore.json` | SLSA provenance v1 for `semgrep.json` (actions/attest-build-provenance), signer `attestation-contract.yml` |
| `semgrep.reusable.sigstore.json` | Same subject, signed from `reusable-attest.yml` (Build Signer URI = reusable, Build Config URI = caller) |
| `semgrep.message-signature.sigstore.json` | `sigstore sign` message signature over the report bytes (no in-toto statement) |
| `trivy.json`, `image.vuln.sigstore.json` | Trivy report and cosign `vuln` attestation for `alpine@sha256:d9e853e8…` |
| `github-attestations-<digest12>.json` | GitHub `GET /repos/{repo}/attestations/sha256:<digest>` replies. The image one holds bundles from two runs. `bundle_url` removed: it is a signed (SAS) URL, i.e. a short-lived credential |
| `trusted_root.{production,staging}.json` | Sigstore trust roots as shipped by sigstore-python 4.5.1 (public keys and certificates) |

Certificates carry this repository's public identity (owner/repo names and ids, workflow paths).
To refresh: push to a `fixtures/attest/**` branch and copy `generated-fixtures/` from the commit
the workflow pushes back.
